calculations.B_pre_event_invariant: Q_n=(q_(n-31),...,q_(n-1)), S_n=sum(Q_n), cursor identifies chronological oldest; q_j=x_j^2 and q_j=0 for j<=0.
calculations.B_next: S_(n+1)=E_n-q_(n-31); replace oldest by q_n and advance correct order.
calculations.B_review_result: Conditional algebraic induction checked; not an accepted new theorem or implementation proof.
calculations.B_nonnegative_subtraction: Valid invariant implies q_old<=S_n<=E_n; next total is nonnegative and <=31 Qmax.
calculations.representation_limit: Host unbounded integers do not test source promotions, widening, signed overflow, packing, parsing or arithmetic under corrupted state.

calculations.h_definition: O_c+T_c+max_t(S_c+K_c+G_c) only for fixed-lifetime payload; length-dependent index costs remain length-dependent.
